input: 所有订单的总金额是多少？

args.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total FROM orders

input: 订单金额最高的客户姓名是什么？

args.sql: SELECT c.name AS name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(o.amount) DESC LIMIT 1

input: 哪个商品类别的销售额最高？

args.sql: SELECT p.category AS category FROM products p JOIN orders o ON o.product_id=p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(o.amount) DESC LIMIT 1

input: 电子产品一共卖出了多少件？

args.sql: SELECT SUM(o.quantity) AS qty FROM orders o JOIN products p ON o.product_id=p.product_id WHERE p.category='电子产品'

input: 北京和上海一共多少张订单？

args.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM orders WHERE region IN ('北京','上海')
